title: Binary Number
description: Interactive p5.js simulation for learning binary numbers with toggle buttons for each bit and real-time decimal conversion display.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Binary Numbers
Number Systems
Computer Science
Mathematics
p5.js
prerequisites: Understanding of place value in decimal system
learningObjectives: Calculate the decimal value of a 4-bit binary number by summing the place values 1, 2, 4, and 8 of the bits that are set
Predict the new decimal value before toggling a single bit, then verify the prediction against the real-time display
Explain why each binary place value doubles, allowing four bits to represent every integer from 0 to 15
Construct a target decimal number such as 13 by choosing which of the four bit buttons to turn on
